correctness.rationale: The normalized affine reproducing kernel is exactly 1+3 x dot y. Separate convexity plus positive conditional density yields strict vertex-only norm attainment, with signed kernel extremizers. Inclusion-exclusion on the full Irwin--Hall B-spline density derives the rational finite sum and positivity defect. Conditioning on an added uniform coordinate proves a positive exact quadratic increment. Controlled sinc characteristic-function and local-density asymptotics give 1/20+1/6=13/60 relative correction with O(d^-2) remainder. The package exact-rational checker independently integrates the B-spline formula for 18 dimensions; these tests support but do not replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: The real affine least-squares projector on a uniformly filled box is a canonical multivariate approximation operator. The work computes its exact sharp sup-norm stability constant in every \(d\ge3\), complete norming geometry, exact positivity defect, positive dimension-increment identity, and second-order high-dimensional growth. These are natural full-parameter invariants needed to quantify how projection stability scales with number of coordinates; the 13/60 correction is not a known low-dimensional-table recomputation. The d=1,2 values are expressly not claimed new.
